notes:
Accountability gets its own tab, reports go by email only, and you can be CC'd

The contact, end-of-day time, name and sending account move out of Settings onto an Accountability
page that also shows when the last report went. Webhooks are gone: reports, the intro note and the
"you've been replaced" notice are emailed from your own address, copying you unless you turn that
off. Inputs on settings pages keep one width beside long descriptions.
